newsitem.title: USA: NationsBanc's Hayes named U.S. muni board chair.
newsitem.headline: NationsBanc's Hayes named U.S. muni board chair.

text.p: Roger Hayes, managing director of municipal finance for NationsBanc Capital Markets, Inc, was elected chairman of Municipal Securities Rulemaking Board for the fiscal year beginning Oct 1, MSRB announced Monday.

And Charles Mires, assistant vice president and manager of the municipal bond division for Allstate Insurance Co in Northbrook, Ill., was selected vice chairman for the coming year, MSRB said in a press statement.
Hayes replaces the departing chair, Alice Handy, treasurer of the University of Virginia in Charlottesville, Va.
Mires succeeds the departing vice chairman, Anthony Taddey, executive vice president of BA Securities, Inc. in Los Angeles.

MSRB said Hayes, a 1968 graduate of Duke University, has 24 years of experience in municipal sales, trading, underwriting, and public finance activities. He works at NationsBanc headqaurters in Charlotte, N.C.

Mires was portfolio manager for Bank One in Dayton, Ohio and Flagship Financial before joining Allstate in 1987. He received a B.S. in business and financial economics at Miami University in 1982, MSRB said.
MSRB has 15 members: five representatives of dealer banks, five of securities firms and five public members not associated with any bank dealer or securities firm.
Hayes is a bank dealer representative and Mires is public member.
